pages.title: Hex
pages.text: The Hex is the beloved version of a Vex. Through the impregnation, the Vex's very being transforms, from a near intangible spirit-like lifeform, to one made up of coagulating blood. This new, semi-stable form allows the Hex to survive for a near indefinite duration, unlike the fleeting nature of a Vex. However, this physical body results in the loss of the ability to fly through terrain.
When killed, it has a chance to drop its $(l:weapons/killjoy)$(c)$(o)weapon$().
